position_claim.disclosure: Positions reflect school roster listings sourced through CFBD. They may differ from eligibility on Yahoo or other fantasy platforms, particularly for hybrid players. Fantasy points use Yahoo scoring rules.
position_claim.product_name: College fantasy projections using Yahoo scoring
position_claim.v1_1: platform eligibility as a separately sourced enhancement

hybrid_disclosure.note: thresholds are material: a receiver with two carries and half a point is not a hybrid, however large the percentage

receiving_note: receptions reconcile to the four frozen budget buckets and to team completions. Published receiving yards and touchdowns cover named players only; residual and non-skill receptions carry the remainder and are never redistributed to fantasy players.
wr_te_treatment: opportunity-differentiated, efficiency-neutral; no player-level receiving calibration exists
